newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Equity finances much of Australian Q2 c/a def.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Equity finances much of Australian Q2 c/a def.

text.p: Equity financed much of Australia's current account deficit in the June quarter, reversing a rundown of foreign equity investment in the previous quarter, Australian Bureau of Statistics figures showed.
Of the A$5.06 billion June quarter current account deficit, equity financed A$2.44 billion, compared with minus A$819 million previously.
Debt supplied A$3.63 billion of the financing, virtually unchanged from A$3.62 billion in the March quarter.
The capital account needed a minus A$1.31 billion balancing item to make it match the current account deficit, as it theoretically must.
Foreign investment classified as neither debt nor equity was valued at A$34 million.
None of the figures are seasonally adjusted.
